Dear Actief Interim Oostkamp,

I am excited to apply for the Warehouse Worker Night Shift position at your client in Oostkamp. With recent hands-on experience in a high-volume logistics environment at Katoen Natie, I have developed the reliability and efficiency needed to excel in this role. I am comfortable operating electrical pallet trucks, working in cold environments, and I am fully committed to night shifts.

In my previous warehouse role, I maintained accuracy and efficiency in a fast-paced setting, ensuring that goods were handled correctly and safely. I am accustomed to the physical demands of the job and take pride in keeping the workspace organized and safe. I am also eager to take on additional responsibilities, such as internal reach truck training, to further contribute to the team.

I am already living in Belgium with a valid address and have legal permission to work. I have my own transportation, so I can easily commute to Oostkamp. I am available to start immediately and am looking for a stable, long-term position where I can grow.

Your offer of a permanent contract after a successful interim period, along with the night and freezer bonuses, is very appealing. I am confident that my strong work ethic and positive attitude will make me a valuable addition to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your logistics operations.

Sincerely,
